name: hanobi
description: A lightweight desktop harness for any LLM: subscriptions, API keys, local models, and MCP connectors. Runs on macOS 12+.

extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Hanobi accesses project folders you choose in Downloads so your coding agent can read and edit their files.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Hanobi accesses project folders you choose in Documents so your coding agent can read and edit their files.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Hanobi accesses project folders you choose on Desktop so your coding agent can read and edit their files.

author: Moosa Yousaf
